figurative_meaning_en: The most precious or best jewel
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই প্রকল্পটি কোম্পানির মুকুটমণি হিসেবে পরিচিত।
example_sentences_in_english: Rabindranath Tagore is the crown jewel of Bengali literature.
This project is known as the crown jewel of the company.
history: The idiom is frequently associated with Rabindranath Tagore, highlighting his status as the pinnacle of Bengali cultural heritage.
note: Commonly used in literary and nationalistic contexts to denote excellence.
